app/src/routes/+page.svelte:41-44 — `goto(..., { reset: false, replace: true })` uses the new Kit 3 option names (`reset` replaced keepFocus/noScroll, `replace` replaced replaceState)
app/src/routes/+error.svelte:2 — `page` from `$app/state`, the current module ($app/stores was removed in Kit 3)
app/src/lib/components/Section.svelte:1-8 — runes ($props) + snippets ({@render children()}), no slots
app/src/lib/components/MoveTable.svelte:53-56 — `$derived.by` for the sorted rows; keyed each blocks throughout

latest_apis.rationale: Consistently on the current generation — SvelteKit 3.1.1 released 2026-10-29 with runes, snippets, `$app/state` and even the renamed Kit 3 `goto` options — with one real gap: raw `process.env` instead of the framework's new explicit env-var declaration.

platform.rationale: Platform-first in the places that matter (URL/URLSearchParams, native form controls, custom properties, link-based pagination), with a couple of hand-rolled spots (debounce timer lifecycle, concurrency limiter) where nothing better exists or it's too minor to matter.

evidence: app/package.json:9-14 — zero runtime dependencies; only five first-party devDependencies

app/package.json:11-13 — @sveltejs/kit ^3.1.1, svelte ^5.57.3, vite ^8.3.5, vite-plugin-svelte ^7.3.1 — the exact current stack SvelteKit 3 requires (per migration guide: Svelte ≥5.57.1, Vite ≥8.0.12, vite-plugin-svelte 7)
app/package.json:15-16 — @sveltejs/adapter-node ^6.0.1, the version paired with Kit 3 (npm shows 6.0.1 published 2026-10-29)
app/package.json:7 — `npm start` = `node build`, the adapter-node output, no extra server dependency
dependencies.rationale: Minimal and modern: every dependency is first-party, current-major, and load-bearing; no CSS framework, no state library, no polyfills.

evidence: app/src/lib/server/api.js:1-75 — all API access (base URL, caching, concurrency) behind one module; every load function goes through it
app/src/lib/server/data.js — shared data assembly (species lists, type/generation records, pokemon-ref resolution) reused by five routes
app/src/lib/utils.js — display helpers in one environment-agnostic module imported by both server and components
app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/+page.server.js:2-3 — deep relative imports `../../../lib/...`; Kit 3's generated projects use `#lib` subpath imports declared in package.json

app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/+page.svelte:79 and app/src/lib/components/PokemonCard.svelte:19 — `style:--pill-bg="var(--type-{type.name})"` interpolates API names into CSS variable names in five files; a shared TypePill component would centralize this coupling
app/src/lib/server/data.js:1-2 — no TypeScript or JSDoc types anywhere (typeLines: 0); raw PokeAPI JSON shapes flow untyped from api.js into components
churn_resistance.rationale: Upgrading the framework would touch very few files — data access, config and helpers are each behind one module and nothing relies on internals. The main churn risks are the absence of types at the API boundary, deep relative imports, and the repeated type-name-to-CSS-variable interpolation.

findings.issue: Reads `process.env.API_BASE_URL` directly instead of using SvelteKit 3's explicit environment variables (`defineEnvVars` + `$app/env/private`), which validate values and stay runtime-agnostic.
findings.suggestion: Add `src/env.js` with `defineEnvVars({ API_BASE_URL: { schema: v.pipe(v.string(), v.url()) } })` and import from `$app/env/private`; this also fails fast on a misconfigured deployment.

findings.issue: The app is plain JavaScript with no types at the API boundary: raw PokeAPI record shapes (species, pokemon, move, type) propagate untyped from `api()` through loads into component props, so a shape change surfaces at runtime, not at compile time.
findings.suggestion: Add JSDoc `@typedef`s for the API records consumed (or adopt TypeScript), at least for the fields the app touches.

findings.issue: Deep relative imports (`../../../lib/server/api.js`) in every route instead of the `#lib` subpath-import alias that SvelteKit 3 projects declare in package.json.
findings.suggestion: Declare `"imports": { "#lib/*": "./src/lib/*" }` in app/package.json and import from `#lib/...` — survives file moves and matches what `sv create` generates.

findings.issue: The debounce timer is never cleared when the component unmounts; a keystroke followed by navigation fires `goto` afterwards, and stale debounces aren't cancelled against each other beyond the last one.
findings.suggestion: Reset/clear the timer in `$effect(() => () => clearTimeout(debounce))` or use a small `$effect`-cleanup pattern.

findings.issue: `{#key data.selectedGame}` remounts all move tables on every game change; the Svelte best-practices guidance reserves `{#key}` for transitions and recommends `$derived` (which MoveTable already uses for its rows).
findings.suggestion: Drop the `{#key}` block — the tables update via props; if resetting the per-table sort on game change is intended, key only `sortOverride`/`sortDir` as state reset.

findings.issue: Build artifacts exist in the app directory but the repo's .gitignore only covers `/data/`, `/.data-cache/` and `node_modules/`, so generated output can end up in version control and churn on every build.
findings.suggestion: Add an `app/.gitignore` (or root entries) for `build/` and `.svelte-kit/`.

findings.issue: Hand-written body omits `data-sveltekit-preload-data="hover"` and the `display: contents` wrapper that the current generated template includes, so link-hover preloading is disabled.
findings.suggestion:
Match the current `sv create` template: `
%sveltekit.body%
`.

findings.issue: The `var(--type-{name})` custom-property interpolation is copy-pasted across five files (PokemonCard, MoveTable, three pages), coupling API type names to CSS token names in each.
findings.suggestion: Extract a `TypePill` component that owns the pill styling and the type→variable lookup.

summary: This app sits squarely on the current generation of the framework: SvelteKit 3.1.1 with config in vite.config.js, Svelte 5 runes and snippets everywhere, `$app/state`, and even the renamed Kit 3 `goto` options — no legacy Svelte patterns at all, and the dependency set is five first-party, current-major packages with zero runtime deps. The few gaps are a hand-rolled `process.env` read where Kit 3 now provides `defineEnvVars`/`$app/env/private`, the absence of types at the API boundary, and some copy-pasted type-pill styling. It would take a framework upgrade with almost no code changes and an afternoon of cleanups to be exemplary.

apis.replacement: defineEnvVars in src/env.js + import from $app/env/private (SvelteKit 3; $env/* modules are deprecated and will be removed in Kit 4)
prefer $derived for reactive re-computation per Svelte best-practices guidance
